registration.title: Keeper skills: shot-stopping, goals prevented, distribution
registration.what: Three 0 to 100 skills for keepers, against other keepers: save %, his team's xG conceded minus goals conceded per 90 (with the defence in front of him), and pass accuracy, with the same one-way level pull as the outfield skills. Only the skill scores change; keeper ranks don't.
registration.why: The owner's look over the live site, 2026-10-22: Alisson should have a saves skill.
registration.how: Keeper branch in skill_scores, player_ratings.py (experiments/keeper_skills/DESIGN.md); the Players list sorts by them through site_players.
registration.hypothesis: None to test: a new output. Every rank stays as it was.
registration.success_criteria: experiments/keeper_skills/report.py: every rank, season rank, position rank, projection and predicted XI identical, base against changed.
